captions.detailed: A compact square utility fan colored in dark charcoal grey, supported by a matching U-shaped stand. It features a circular front grille exposing internal fan blades, a bright orange speed control knob on the right side of the housing, and a small black folding hanging hook nested on the top surface. The main fan housing can tilt vertically relative to the stand, the internal fan blades spin freely, the side knob rotates to adjust speed, and the top hook can swing upwards for hanging.
captions.instruction: Create a 3D model of a compact utility fan with a square housing, a circular front grille, a U-shaped support stand, a side-mounted orange speed dial, and a small folding hook on top. The model should have articulations allowing the housing to tilt on the stand, the fan blades to spin, the speed dial to rotate, and the hanging hook to fold up and down.
captions.factory: Construct the main stand using a U-shaped frame extruded from a sketched profile. Build the square fan housing by extruding a rounded square, pocketing out a large central cylinder for the grille, and modeling a grid of intersecting ribs. Create the fan blades using a central hub cylinder with angled helical or swept blade shapes. Model the side speed dial as a multi-faceted cylinder colored orange and the top hook as a thin closed-loop sweep. Define joints for the housing tilt (revolute), the fan blades (continuous), the speed knob (continuous), and the top hook (revolute).
